descriptionHtml:
Case Specifications

  • Model: Aerocool P500C

  • Case Type: Mid-Tower

  • Color: Black

  • Body Material: SPCC Steel

  • Side Panel: Tempered Glass

  • Front Panel: High-airflow Mesh design

  • Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX

  • Pre-installed Fans: 4 x 120mm ARGB fans (3 x Front, 1 x Rear)

  • Fan Support:

    • Front: 3 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm

    • Top: 2 x 120mm or 2 x 140mm

    • Rear: 1 x 120mm

  • Radiator Support:

    • Front: Up to 360mm

    • Top: Up to 240mm

  • Clearance:

    • Max GPU Length: Up to 346mm

    • Max CPU Cooler Height: Up to 164mm

  • Drive Bays: 2 x 3.5” HDD and 2 x 2.5” SSD

  • I/O Panel: 2 x USB 3.0, HD Audio & Mic, Power/Reset Button
